Package com.neueda.leap.order.model

Class Account

java.lang.Object
com.neueda.leap.order.model.Account
@Entity(name="OrderAccount") public class Account extends Object
Account entity representing a trading account. BR-04, BR-05, BR-11: Trading accounts with tier constraints and execution buffer.
